Soft pieces

Vegetable patties

Zöldséges fasírt

8 months+ Adjusted 35 min 4 portions

Serve soft strips or a mashed spoonful. Peas should be crushed, not left whole and firm.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 80 g broccoli (cooked until soft)
  • 1 small carrot (cooked until soft)
  • 40 g peas (cooked and crushed)
  • 150 g chicken or rabbit mince
  • 10 g mild hard cheese (pasteurized, finely grated)
  • 1 small clove garlic (finely chopped)
  • 1 tsp olive oil (if pan-cooked)

Allergens

milk

Method

  1. Cook the broccoli, carrot, and peas until very soft, then chop them and crush the peas.
  2. Mix in the mince, cheese, and garlic, and add no salt and no pepper.
  3. Shape small flat patties. No egg is needed.
  4. Bake at 190 C, or cook in a thin film of oil over moderate heat, until the meat is cooked through and the outside stays soft.
  5. Do not brown them hard, then cool slightly and cut into soft strips or mash.

Adjusted

The usual patties were salted and peppered, then browned until the outside was firm. That crust is harder than an 8-month-old needs.

Mix broccoli, carrot, pea, and chicken or rabbit mince with a little cheese and garlic, with no salt and no pepper. Bake the patties, or cook them in a thin film of oil over moderate heat, until they stay soft rather than browned hard.
